text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Sirius. The fact that I<n>am able to
celebrate this day with you<n>every year fills me with
immeasurable joy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As a token of our enduring friendship,<n>I've
arranged for flowers to be sent<n>to your room.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Right... All hail the Emperor, the<n>master of flattery
and sycophancy.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Come on, you know that's not what<n>I want to
hear from you. So, how<n>about it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, in other words... you wish for<n>us to stand
shoulder to shoulder as<n>both friends and rivals?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Close, but not quite. I want you onedge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How intriguing. So we should fight<n>tooth and nail—is
that it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Not even close. I'm talking survival of<n>the fittest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How concerning... I had hoped we<n>could bury the
hatchet.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but you actually love it,<n>don't
you—unsheathing your claws<n>and stabbing your
enemies from<n>behind?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch, I'll tear away that<n>goody
two-shoes act of yours in an<n>instant.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... So your strength comes from<n>steely
conviction. I, too, must take<n>measures lest I fall
behind.
